verdict.rationale: Pulley is an equity-management SaaS platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no mention of an MCP server; it shows only an llms.txt help-center index and no OpenAPI spec, neither of which is an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
